name: compdf-compress-pdf
tagline_zh: PDF胖成球？一键压缩，肉眼难辨画质损失。连扫描件里的噪点都帮你清掉，文件瘦身却像没动过刀。
tagline_en: Slim down bloated PDFs with invisible quality loss—even cleans scan noise. Looks untouched, weighs far less.
desc_en: Compress PDF files with ComPDF while balancing file size and readable visual quality. Use for PDF optimization, resolution control, compression strategies, and removal of non-essential document content.
why_zh: 别的工具只会无脑压像素，它懂得先剥离冗余内容，再按视觉重要性分配比特，所以小而不糊。
why_en: Unlike blind pixel crushers, it strips non-essential content first, then allocates bits by visual importance—small yet sharp.
